t: The 4lite Kithara square 600mm x 600mm LED backlit panel light delivers bright, uniform illumination for various indoor settings. This 33W, 3300 lumen daylight 6000K LED panel is ideal for commercial spaces, educational facilities, and ancillary areas such as offices, corridors, and workshops. Its slimline design allows for straightforward installation into shallow ceiling voids. Featuring a durable steel body and a TP(b) rated diffuser, this non-dimmable panel ensures reliable performance. The integrated LED technology offers a 50,000-hour life, offering a long-lasting lighting solution.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
